system.description:
You manifest 2 gems made of Fire Release Chakra that feel hot to the touch.

A creature can use its bonus action to eat one gem, eating a gem allows the consuming creature to spend up to 2 of their own Hit die, regaining hit points equal to the spent dice. They also gain a number of Temporary Hit points equal to 2d6 + 4. A creature can gain the benefits of this jutsu once every hour.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the temporary hit points by 1d6.
